content.short: DEXTools is a decentralized exchange data and analysis platform for traders.
content.description: DEXTools provides information on token pairs across a broad range of blockchains and DeFi protocols. Traders can gain timely insights into new token pairs and exchange activity, while staying up to date with activity related to known pairs and tokens across multiple networks. Community managers can monitor DeFi protocols and tokens of interest through the recently updated tabs, enabling them to follow developments and observe trends across the supported networks.
content.meta: DEXTools provides information on token pairs across multiple supported blockchains and DeFi protocols. Discover DEXTools and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
